item.title: VIDEO: : Residents scoop fuel as petrol tanker overturns on Lagos bridge
item.description: A petrol-laden tanker has overturned on the Tincan Liverpool Bridge, in the Apapa area of Lagos, with hordes of residents and passersby scooping petrol from beneath the bridge.
